current.text: Yahoo lists him as questionable with a hip injury.

His fantasy value is finished after Utah drafted Darryn Peterson.
Utah has a crowded group of guards and wings: George, Peterson, Sensabaugh, Bailey, Markkanen and Jackson Jr.
Markkanen, Keyonte George, Jaren Jackson Jr. and Peterson take most of the usage, and everyone else will lose touches.
Utah plans to win this season and is not tanking. Experts expect a playoff team, so the late-season minutes he got last season will not be there.
